# mizchi-mode

> Careful working mode that replaces the default autonomous development style for the rest of the session — strict TDD (explore, Red, Green, Refactor), questions before acting on unclear instructions, and an approved plan before any file change. Invoke only when the user types /mizchi-mode or says "mizchi-mode", or when the project's CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md says to work in mizchi-mode.

## Install

### APM (recommended)

```bash
apm install mizchi/skills/mizchi-mode
```

Or declare it in `apm.yml` for a reproducible setup:

```yaml
dependencies:
  apm:
    - mizchi/skills/mizchi-mode
```

then run `apm install`.

### Any agentskills.io-compatible agent

This is an [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) skill — a portable
`SKILL.md` folder that works with Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Gemini CLI,
Cursor, and other [compatible agents](https://agentskills.io/clients).

With the [`skills`](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills) CLI (installs into
every detected agent's skills directory):

```bash
npx skills add mizchi/skills --skill mizchi-mode
```

Or copy the folder in directly:

```bash
npx degit mizchi/skills/mizchi-mode ~/.claude/skills/mizchi-mode
```

See [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) for what this skill does and when to use it.
